data.one_liner: Paints a moving highlight over skeleton placeholders and call-to-action text.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget that applies a moving highlight effect using shaders. It is commonly used for creating skeleton screens during loading states or sliding highlights on call-to-action text.
use_when: You need to display skeleton loading placeholder screens for asynchronous data.
You want to create a sliding highlight effect on text or buttons like a slide-to-unlock feature.
avoid_when: You are wrapping individual rows in separate Shimmer widgets within a long list instead of wrapping the whole list.
Your app does not meet the Flutter >=3.44.0 requirement introduced in version 4.0.0.
strengths: Lightweight widget utilizing a ShaderMaskLayer for efficient rendering.
Supports customizable gradients, direction, period, loops, and enabled state.
weaknesses: Requires using the standalone material_ui package and Flutter >=3.44.0 in version 4.0.0.
Complex child widgets with images or decorated text may render incorrectly because the shader replaces their colors.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the shimmer dependency and the standalone material_ui package (Flutter 3.44+).

alternatives.name: skeletonizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative package listed in catalog for skeleton placeholders.
